newsitem.title: UK: LME zinc hits new 7-yr high in evening trade.
newsitem.headline: LME zinc hits new 7-yr high in evening trade.

text.p: Zinc maintained its upward climb to hit a new seven-high year of $1,588 during London Metal Exchange evening trade on Thursday.
At 1800 GMT, the metal was indicated at $1,585/$1,590, up from the kerb close of $1,571 which was a $20 up from the previous day's afternoon close.
"The fundamental picture remains bullish, as do we," broker Rudolf Wolff said in an evening metal report. It pegged initial resistance at $1,580, with a primary target at $1,600.
Copper also rose, indicated at $2,317/$2,325 against the kerb close of $2,296, and aluminium held gains at $1,658/$1,660. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 4985
